mechanism: Phenelzine is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor that inhibits CYP3A4, significantly increasing lopinavir levels and exposure, while lopinavir may inhibit phenelzine metabolism; combined effect risks severe hypertension, serotonin syndrome, and cardiotoxicity.
action: Avoid concomitant use; if necessary, use alternative antiretroviral with minimal CYP3A4 interaction and monitor blood pressure and mental status closely with dose adjustments.
